description: Implementation of the ProductDao interface, providing data access methods for Product entities, including retrieval by SEO URL, by locale, by category, and by ID or code, utilizing JPA/Hibernate queries with fetch joins to optimize loading related entities.

classes.name: ProductDaoImpl
classes.description: Data access implementation class for Product; enabling retrieval and querying of Product entities with various filters and criteria.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Fetches a Product by its SEO URL for a given store and locale, using a complex HQL query with multiple fetch joins.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products available for a given store, set of category IDs, language, and locale.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Returns distinct products within specified categories, optimized for listing performance.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories (overload with Language parameter)
methods.description: Enhanced version including language filtering and availability constraints.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Lists products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves products belonging to a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByStore (with criteria)
methods.description: Provides a paginated, filtered list of products for a store, supporting complex search criteria.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Fetches a specific product by ID, tailored to locale and language, with fetch joins.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its ID with associated fetch joins for related entities.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Finds a product by SKU code, including descriptive and related entities.
